name: checkbox
description: The checkbox primitive: a native <input type="checkbox"> with the themed look and a visible focus ring. Native on purpose — in the tab order, toggles on Space, reports checked/indeterminate to assistive tech with no ARIA wiring. Carries no label; pair it with field or a wrapping label.

notes: A native checkbox — focusable, Space-toggled and announced with its checked state with no extra wiring
Shows a visible focus-visible ring for keyboard users
Needs a label via field, a wrapping <label>, or aria-label

intents: a checkbox / boolean toggle in a form
examples: <label className="flex items-center gap-2"><Checkbox name="terms" /> Accept the terms</label>
